text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Automated page fired for service `inference-gateway-prod` — sudden 5xx error-rate spike in region `us-west2`. Alert: error_rate > 5% for 3m. PD:PD-20345
PagerDuty: PagerDuty incident PD-20345 created and routed to on-call (ryan).
ryan: ack'd — looking. any immediate customer reports?
lisa: I'm seeing a sharp jump in origin 502s from the us-west2 edge — looks like keepalive resets + upstream 502. quick query: `sum(rate(http_server_errors[1m])) by (region)` shows 6x baseline for us-west2.
marta: tagging customers who hit high error volumes: a few heavy clients on dedicated capacity — @customer-ops can you validate if any customer-facing alerts fired?
customer-ops: confirmed two customers reported increased errors via support forms ~10m ago. severity: elevated but not yet escalated to account teams.
ryan: quick mitigation plan: 1) enable fallback routing to eu-west for new sessions, 2) disable problematic upstream pool (us-west2-pool-7), 3) scale gateway pods by +30% for backend fanout. Anyone on runbook?
sam: runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/inference-gateway-5xx. recommend `kubectl cordon` then drain problematic nodes, but prefer draining pods behind LB first.
lisa: I'm running a logs query now — snippet:
```
# kql example
requests
| where region == "us-west2" and status_code >= 500
| summarize count() by upstream_pool, status_code
| sort by count_ desc
```
Result: us-west2-pool-7 => 72% of 5xx (mostly 502), some 504s as well.
ryan: ok disabling pool 7 from routing now. ops-bot: run `trafficctl disable-pool us-west2-pool-7 --reason "502 flood"`.
ops-bot: command acknowledged — disabling pool us-west2-pool-7. healthcheck will complete in ~15s. :white_check_mark:
PagerDuty: PD-20345 acknowledged by ryan at 2025-10-18T12:02:28Z.
marta: can we confirm if KV cache evictions correlate? I see a spike in cache misses at the same time which could amplify tail latency.
lisa: cache miss rate up ~3x across us-west2, but upstream 502s are primary. still looking at sidecars and proxy pools.
ryan: starting gradual rollback of the last deploy (inference-gateway 1.42.0 -> 1.41.8) to test if bad rollout triggered this. will hold for 5m and observe.
sam: if rollback not helping, fallback to canary variant (model-proxy v2) as low-risk. also enabling aggressive connection reuse: `envoy: connection_reuse: true` on gateway.
customer-ops: account teams updated: two affected customers routed to eu-west fallback, latency will increase ~60-80ms, customers advised.
lisa: health checks improving — 5xx rate dropping to ~2.1% from 5.8% after pool disable and partial rollback. continuing to watch p99 latency.
ryan: good. I'll leave the PD incident open and escalate to SRE lead if >10m to stable. handoff note for on-call rotation: if I need sleep, please pick up at 12:35 UTC — leave runbook link and actions taken.
marta: documented actions in incident doc: https://incidents.internal/redwood/PD-20345 — pool disabled, partial rollback initiated, fallback routing to eu-west enabled. next: evaluate root cause (deploy vs infra) and postmortem owner.
ops-bot: autoscale triggered +2 gateway pods in us-west2 (policy: p95-latency).
ryan: monitoring shows error-rate trending down, p95 latency stable. I'm staying on for 10m then handing off to lisa for follow-up. :thumbsup:
lisa: taking over at 12:35 UTC — will validate backend health and start root cause triage.
PagerDuty: PD-20345 status updated: Investigating -> Mitigated by ryan at 2025-10-18T12:12:01Z.
incident-bot: note: create postmortem if incident duration > 30m or customer-impacting. current duration ~12m.
customer-ops: customers notified of mitigation and estimated RTO. no escalations to account teams at this time.
ryan: thanks team. leaving runbook and logs in the doc. lisa, please continue with RCA. I'll append notes to the ticket before handing off.
lisa: acknowledged. continuing triage, will ping when we have root cause or need further escalation. :eyes:
